scope: Your answers to the design questions: What's playing, Undo and Redo, message details, safer email, and more.

topics.title: What's playing
details: Press F3, or say what's playing, to hear the station, episode or file.
If a radio station stops, you hear it once, with what to do next.
Say play WGN from almost any screen to play a station.

topics.title: Undo and Redo
details: Control+Z and Control+Y undo and redo up to 100 steps in documents and email.
You can also say undo or redo. Each one says what changed.

topics.title: Message details
details: Alt+1 says who a message is from. Alt+2 is To, Alt+3 is CC, Alt+4 is the subject, Alt+5 is the date, and Alt+6 is the number of files.
You can also say who sent this, or when was it sent.

topics.title: Email
details: Leaving an email you wrote now asks if you want to save it, throw it away, or keep writing.
Opening a message now says Message opened.

topics.title: Help and the main menu
details: Help now tells you when it did not understand you.
On the main menu, words it does not know get a reply that says where you are and to press F1.

topics.title: Saving and favorites
details: Say save to save your document or email.
Deleting a web favorite asks first. After you save a favorite, you go back to the page.

topics.title: The hint line
details: The line at the bottom of the window now fits the screen you are on.

topics.title: Radio
details: After a station that would not play, the next station now plays.
